text.name: Assault Banner
text.description:
{Assault Banner}

+3 Attack for the equipped troop. One item per troop. Move it through the troop equipment screen.
text.event: A banner is added to your backpack.

text.name: Guardian Banner
text.description:
{Guardian Banner}

+3 Defense for the equipped troop. One item per troop. Move it through the troop equipment screen.
text.event: A banner is added to your backpack.

text.name: Warding Banner
text.description:
{Warding Banner}

Magic damage received by the equipped troop is reduced by 20%. One item per troop. Move it through the troop equipment screen.
text.event: A banner is added to your backpack.
